tei:l.tei:note: It is incumbent on the men of action to study on the new moon of Nisan,
immediately after prayer, the portion of establishing the tabernacle,
as a remembrance of the tabernacle which was established on that day:

tei:lg.tei:l: Numbers 7:1–17
Ezekiel 37
Psalms 122
Zohar Bamidbar 3

tei:l.tei:note: And after this first-day reading, say:

tei:lg.tei:l: May it be willed before You,
Cause our God and God of our ancestors,
that important and desired be our reading in the Teaching,
the order of the offering of the prince Naḥshon son of ‘Amminadav
of the tribe of Judah, sealed in kingship,
his offering that he offered
for the rededication of Your holy tabernacle,
and may it ascend for us
as if we exalted all the secrets
and all the holy names
deriving from the first and last-letter acrostics
of these holy occasions,
that our lips may fulfill bulls. (Hosea 14:3)
And may all the sparks of holiness
and all the holy lights
and all the house of Israel our brothers,
included in the sanctity of this tribe,
enlighten us
and may we be clad in the sanctity of this tribe,
to establish and understand Your Teaching,
and, revering you, the highest reverence,
doing Your will as Your will,
all the days of our lives,
us and our seed
and our seed’s seed.
And just as this month
You redeemed Your people
the tribes of Your inheritance
from the iron furnace, from Egypt,
and remembered in love the start,
for a name and for glory,
the names of the tribes of our ancestors,
for the miracles and for the deliverance
and for the mighty acts and for the salvations
that You did with them,
thus, Cause our God and God of our ancestors,
account for Your flock in compassion,
and remember for us the primordial love,
the tribes of Yahh, this exiled force,
the tribe of Judah in struggle and pain,
and just as they thanked the Cause
for Their mercy in leaving Egypt
by Judah’s merit,
so too we will thank You,
Cause our God and God of our ancestors,
for our redemption and for the deliverance of our souls,
by merit of Judah king over his brothers,
and the staff will not depart from Judah
nor the lawgiver from between his legs,
and his seed will forever be,
and his throne like the sun before You,
a king in his beauty will our eyes behold
and our hearts rejoice,
and You will reign, Cause our God
speedily over all Your works,
on Mount Ẓíōn Your holy abode,
and in Jerusalem the city of Your temple,
as is written in Your holy writings:
the Cause will reign forever;
your God, Ẓíōn, from generation to generation,
hallelu–ʝahh! (Psalms 146:10)
And it is said, for the Cause’s is sovereignty,
and rule over all nations. (Psalms 22:29)
And the Cause will rule over all the earth;
on that day the Cause will be one
and Their name will be one. (Zechariah 14:9)
May my mouth’s words
and my heart’s mutterings
be acceptable before You,
Cause, my Rock and Redeemer.
Receive our plea,
and hear our cry,
Knower of Secrets!

tei:l.tei:note: And after that say this prayer on every day

tei:lg.tei:l: May it be willed before You,
Cause our God and God of our ancestors,
that You enlighten today, in Your great mercy,
the holy souls standing in three rows in Eden,
screeching their voices like birds,
and all their souls praise Yahh,
to laud and glorify Your splendid name,
and plea a plea of life and peace upon us,
the children of Your beloved.
Please, in the strength of the force of Your compassion,
may Your ears incline to them,
and hearken to their prayer in compassion,
to nullify from upon us
and from upon all the house of Israel
all anger
and all kinds of destruction
and all kinds of punishment,
and extend our days in good,
and our years in pleasantnesses,
a life of quietude,
a life of goodness,
a life of blessing,
a life of prosperity,
a life of strength of essence,
a life with fear of sin,
a life without shame and disgrace,
a life of wealth and honor for Your service,
a life with love of the Teaching for its own sake,
a life in which the desires of our hearts are filled for good.
And may Your mercy be on these holy souls,
that their good memory ascend
come and arrive,
be seen and be desired,
be heard, be accounted for,
and be remembered
before the throne of Your glory,
and find them rest,
and bind their souls before and behind
in the place of holiness —
no eye has seen it, God, but Yours!
And sate the descendants of their souls;
let them fill up on the richness of Your house,
and drink of Your refreshing stream.
And place our portion with them,
that we merit and live
and inherit goodness and blessing
for the life of the world to come.
And these souls,
scattered and flying like the universal ether,
and those that died before their time
and were handed over to silence,
and those who were hidden in the ground,
that they sprout up from the city
like grass of the land,
for they do not yet have the strength
to go to their rest —
You are the Deity,
who enlightens the land
and those who dwell on it
in compassion!
Shine Your face
and cover their iniquities and crimes,
and say to the angel appointed over them
to lighten from upon them
their judgment and doom
and the yoke of their suffering.
Let the Cause grant them
that they find rest true,
each man to his own rest,
in a rest of peace,
quietude and safety
forevermore.
And in the shelter of the Surveyor
they will lodge under the wings of the mount-angels,
from step to step,
from ascent to ascent
they will raise and ascend,
and for he who lacks merits to ascend,
do him mercy and free gifts,
as is said:
And They said, I will pass all My goodness over your face,
and call in the name of the Cause before you,
and have mercy on whom I will have mercy,
and compassion on whom I will have compassion. (Numbers 33:19)
May my mouth’s words
and my heart’s mutterings
be acceptable before You,
Cause, my Rock and Redeemer. (Psalms 19:15)

tei:l.tei:note: And after this they say Ḳaddish.
It is also explained there that some read on the new moon of Nisan,
after the reading of the prince,
eight portions in which the day of the new moon of Nisan are mentioned,

tei:lg.tei:l: Leviticus 21:1–15
Numbers 8:5–9:14
Numbers 5:1–4
Leviticus 16:1–34
Leviticus 10:8–11
Numbers 8:1–4
Numbers 19:1–22
Blessed is the Cause forever,
amen and amen! (Psalms 89:53)
